about: The asset vault (docs/assets.md "The asset vault"): every vault's pack, licence and files, its tar's and parts' sha256s. Written by tool/asset_vault.py pack (the hand-written fields kept: name, group, pack, licence, needed_by_build, match or slug); read by its check and unpack.

format.tar: ustar; names sorted (UTF-8 bytes); mode 0644, uid/gid 0, no owner names, mtime 2026-01-01; regular files only, no extended headers
format.parts: assets-vault/<name>.tar.gz.enc when it fits one part, else <name>.tar.gz.enc.part01, .part02, ...
format.open: cat assets-vault/<name>.tar.gz.enc* | openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 600000 -md sha256 -pass file:<key file> | tar -xzf - -C <dest>
